meaning:
1) neck, throat
1a) neck
1b) throat
1b1) of open sepulchre (fig.)

elsewhere.note: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter with their tongue.
Moreover Yahweh said, “Because the daughters of Zion are arrogant, and walk with outstretched necks and flirting eyes, walking to trip as they go, jingling…
“Keep your feet from being bare, and your throat from thirst. But you said, ‘It is in vain. No, for I have loved strangers, and I will go after them.’
I decked you with ornaments, put bracelets on your hands, and put a chain on your neck.
